Class NostrPublicKey

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.keypair.NostrPublicKey
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, NostrKey
public final class NostrPublicKey extends Object implements NostrKey
Represents a Nostr public key.

This class provides methods to create a Nostr public key from various formats such as byte arrays, hex strings, and Bech32 strings. It also provides methods to convert the public key to different formats.

    • NostrPublicKey

      public NostrPublicKey(ByteBuffer data)
      Creates a new NostrPublicKey from the given data.

      Note: This constructor directly stores the provided ByteBuffer as an internal reference. Modifying the ByteBuffer externally after passing it to this constructor may lead to unexpected behavior.

      If you don't want to worry about this, use one of the static factory methods such as fromBytes(byte[]) or fromHex(String) that copy the data.

      Parameters:
      data - the ByteBuffer containing the public key data

    • NostrPublicKey

      public NostrPublicKey(ByteBuffer data, boolean verify)
      Creates a new NostrPublicKey from the given data.
      Parameters:
      data - the ByteBuffer containing the public key data
      verify - whether to verify that the x-only key represents a secp256k1 point

    • asReadOnlyBuffer

      public ByteBuffer asReadOnlyBuffer()
      Description copied from interface: NostrKey
      Returns an independent read-only view of the key's internal buffer.

      The returned view has its own position and limit. If the key is backed by direct memory, the view remains direct.

      Specified by:
      asReadOnlyBuffer in interface NostrKey
